topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out that someone, without my consent, has permanently inked my artwork onto their skin. After pouring my heart and soul into every stroke, every line, only for it to be appropriated like this... I can't even begin to describe the intrusion. This isn't about flattery; it's about respect and basic human decency. An artist’s work is an extension of them, and to take that and use it however you want, without even a nod towards acknowledging the creator, is more than just a step over the line—it's a blatant disregard for the labor and love that goes into each piece. I need to think about my next move carefully, but this? This cannot stand.
